scope: Primary retailer evidence for original Mallside shopping interactions and visual refinement; no catalog additions, copied brand art, current real-stock claims, or policy replication authorized by these citations.

sources.title: Special In-Store Services for Members — Nike
sources.evidence: The official page describes scanning product barcodes for sizes and colors, in-store and online; favoriting styles to help find them in-store; and asking store athletes for help.
sources.adaptation: Give the existing associate an exact-product help action with selected size and existing simulated stock. A response should identify a real game product, explain the next physical destination and offer a walk-to-display or fitting action. Generic size advice can remain secondary.
sources.limits: Services are membership/context dependent. Mallside should describe its own simulated inventory, not live Nike store inventory.

sources.title: Store Mode in the App — Zara United Kingdom
sources.evidence: Click and Find shows the floor-plan location of a product placed in the app basket; Click and Go uses the selected store's available catalogue for same-store collection.
sources.adaptation: Connect a selected product to its actual existing display or stock fixture. Show department and actionable floor destination, retaining the correct display page when the player arrives. This makes the shopping interface a companion to physical browsing.
sources.limits: The currently read UK page does not describe fitting-room reservation, so do not infer that feature from older third-party articles.

sources.title: How to find products in-store? — IKEA United States
sources.evidence: Product pages identify a marketplace department for small products or aisle and bin for larger self-serve items.
sources.adaptation: Use stable, readable department and fixture references instead of another abstract catalogue modal. A product help result can say which physical display has the item and guide the player there.
sources.limits: Do not recreate IKEA warehouse procedures in every fashion shop; adapt the general principle of product-to-location clarity.

sources.title: Fitting Room Usage Policy Update — UNIQLO Malaysia Customer Service
sources.evidence: The FAQ describes fitting-room guidance during busy periods, staff flexibility for practical needs, and staff keeping remaining merchandise together in a shopping basket while a customer tries the current selection.
sources.adaptation: Make fitting status and retained unpaid selections explicit. Keep the player's chosen items intact while trying one item, with clear return-to-browsing and next-size help. Physical waiting positions should remain separate from room occupants and access routes.
sources.limits: The three-item policy is specific to this region and peak periods; do not impose it globally in Mallside or invent a mandatory delay.

sources.title: About In-Store Purchase Self-Checkout — UNIQLO Malaysia Customer Service
sources.evidence: The official sequence is place basket in the counter space, review items on the display, pay, and bag the items.
sources.adaptation: Make unpaid carried selections visibly distinct from purchased bags. At the existing physical counter, show item names, size and total before payment, followed by a bagging/receipt confirmation. Any animation should preserve the existing atomic purchase transaction.
sources.limits: Do not copy the regional paper-bag fee or payment methods. Additional timed stages should be skippable and should not conceal payment outcomes.

sources.title: Apple Union Square Highlights New Design Elements, Community Programs — Apple Newsroom
sources.evidence: The primary launch account describes themed perimeter display bays with experts at displays, side-by-side support, public seating and gathering space.
sources.adaptation: Refine original perimeter merchandise bays into coherent themed groupings with restrained fixed signs and small purposeful details. Leave a clear central browse aisle, comfortable pause points and visible associate presence rather than filling walkable space with arbitrary decoration.
sources.limits: Historical design precedent, not a claim about all present-day Apple stores. No Apple photography, distinctive architecture or branded fixture art should be copied.

implementationPriorities: Replace purely generic associate dialogue with exact-product, exact-size game assistance connected to physical browsing.
Ensure product-to-fixture routing works for off-page products and changed departments without spending money or reducing stock.
Refine visible checkout and fitting props only where they communicate an existing gameplay action.

Improve personal space in shopper routes and queues; this is a game-design inference from the desired experience, not a measured behavior claim from the sources. Test both separation and eventual transaction progress to prevent deadlocks.
